description_en: Queries the numbers of IP addresses in the IP address whitelist and IP address blacklist of an Anti-DDoS Proxy instance
description_zh: 查询针对DDoS高防实例的黑名单和白名单IP的数量
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-auto-cc-list-count --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --query-type manual --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAutoCcListCount

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance.

You can call the DescribeInstanceIds operation to query the IDs of all instances

parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:

manual: manually added
